reflectionQuestion: When you think about the people praying through the night for Peter — so earnest in their pleading yet so stunned when he actually appeared at the door — have you ever found yourself caught between the anxiety of desperate prayer and the unsettling surprise of it being answered?
title: Peter Delivered from Prison
reflectionText: When you think about the people praying through the night for Peter — so earnest in their pleading yet so stunned when he actually appeared at the door — have you ever found yourself caught between the anxiety of desperate prayer and the unsettling surprise of it being answered?
